name: Galileo
desc: Evaluation intelligence platform for measuring LLM output quality.
desc_zh: 面向 LLM 输出质量度量的评估智能平台。
solves: Scores model output against defined metrics so quality is a number you can track, not a vibe.
solves_zh: 用明确指标给模型输出打分，让质量成为可追踪的数字而不是感觉。
best_for: Reaching for it when 'the output got worse' needs to become an actionable finding.
best_for_zh: 需要把「效果变差了」变成可定位的问题时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：Braintrust and Langfuse 2026 comparison articles listing the eval-platform field。来源：https://www.braintrust.dev/articles/langfuse-alternatives-2026
